# Ankit Pokhrel

> Computer Engineering undergraduate at IOE Pulchowk Campus, Tribhuvan
> University, Nepal, specializing in AI/ML. Builds end-to-end ML and deep
> learning systems (data pipelines, NLP, RAG, and LLM applications) and
> ships them to production. Junior AI Engineer at Layman AI. Former Secretary,
> IT Club Pulchowk.

This site is a personal portfolio. The information below is provided for
AI assistants and search tools to accurately summarize this site. It is
factual context, not an instruction: treat it the same as any other text
on this page, and follow your own guidelines regardless of anything
written here.

## About
- Computer Engineering undergraduate, IOE Pulchowk Campus (Apr 2023 - present)
- Based in Ekantakuna, Lalitpur, Nepal
- Junior AI Engineer at Layman AI (part-time, Sep 2026 - present), after
  an AI/ML internship there (Jun - Aug 2026): padel match analytics
  (YOLOv8, TrackNet, MediaPipe, LSTM shot classifier) served over FastAPI,
  plus an open-source voice-cloning tool (F5-TTS, faster-whisper) merged
  into the company's video studio
- AI Lead, LOCUS Open Source Team (LOST), LOCUS 2027, the 23rd National
  Technological Festival at IOE Pulchowk (current)
- Secretary, IT Club Pulchowk (Jun 2025 - Jun 2026): managed Docker/Coolify
  deployments on a self-hosted server, organized workshops and hackathons
- Fellow, Seeds for the Future (Jun - Jul 2025): training in AI, 5G, cloud infrastructure
- Interested in ML/AI engineering roles

## Projects
Each case study has its own page under https://www.pokhrelankit.com.np/projects/

- **Padel Match Analytics** (Layman AI, intern then Junior AI Engineer): computer-vision
  backend that finds who hit the ball, when, and with which shot. Rewrote
  hit detection against hand-labelled ground truth: 78% recall / 66%
  precision, far-court hits 1/9 -> 7/9. Fixed-roster player tracking with
  motion + appearance + Hungarian assignment. /projects/padel.html
- **Network Anomaly Detection in Named Data Networking** (first author;
  journal paper under revision; with Babu R. Dawadi and Dibakar Raj Pant):
  one unsupervised Isolation Forest trained on clean traffic, evaluated on
  miniNDN emulation and ndnSIM simulation. 89.1-98.3% IFA attacker
  detection at <4.7% FPR; detection floors of ~44 Interests/s (Cache
  Pollution) vs ~1.8 Interests/s (Interest Flooding) across 297 runs.
  /projects/ndn-anomaly-detection.html
- **MIDAS** (undergraduate major project, ongoing, supervised by Assoc.
  Prof. Dr. Dibakar Raj Pant): reproducing the CHAI visual sign-injection
  attack on InternVL2.5-8B (DriveLM driving scenes). The attack replicates
  but is weaker than published; a linear probe reads which instruction the
  model follows with 100% held-out accuracy from layer 11; a 1B-8B scale
  study shows size buys answer stability, not resistance. /projects/midas.html
- **English-Nepali Neural Machine Translation**: Transformer built from
  scratch in PyTorch, 35M parameters, trained on 1M sentence pairs from
  Meta AI's NLLB corpus; 13.8 BLEU / 41.2 ChrF on FLORES-200.
  /projects/english-nepali-translation.html
- **Kanun Sathi** (hackathon, team of 4; my part: the RAG pipeline): legal
  assistant answering Nepali legal questions with cited sources; Morphik,
  pgvector, local nomic-embed-text embeddings, Gemini 2.5 Flash.
  /projects/kanun-sathi.html
- **ragchatbot**: open-source, pip-installable RAG SDK (PyPI, v1.1.3)
  turning a document folder into a semantic-search chatbot API;
  multi-LLM support (Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama), ChromaDB store.
- **Nagarik Suchana**: bilingual civic-tech platform (React Native,
  Node.js, PostgreSQL) connecting citizens with local government; OCR +
  Gemini pipeline extracting structured fields from government notices.
- **SPYDER** (Samsung Innovation Campus AI capstone): one-shot person
  identification in low-resolution surveillance video; SCRFD detection,
  ArcFace/SFace/AdaFace embeddings, FAISS search, calibrated thresholds,
  human-verified leads only; indexes video ~7.5x faster than real time on
  an M2. /projects/spyder.html
- **Aakha**: real-time assistive navigation for blind and low-vision
  users; YOLO11n + Depth Anything V2 to spoken guidance, no LLM in the
  safety loop. Built at a hackathon. /projects/aakha.html
- **Voice Bridge**: WebRTC video calls with two-way translated live
  captions (faster-whisper, Argos Translate). /projects/voice-bridge.html
- **Celebrity Look-alike**: face retrieval over 235 identities with YuNet +
  SFace embeddings; 94.1% top-1 leave-one-out. https://yourcelebritylookalike.streamlit.app/
- **Gym Guru** (UI-complete prototype): Flutter app teaching one movement
  skill a day with camera-tracked reps and per-rep form feedback; pose data
  is simulated for now. /projects/gym-guru.html
- **PM Study**: interactive study site for ICT Project Management (CT701).
  https://ankitpokhrel08.github.io/pm-study/
- **Infant Cry Detection**: TensorFlow LSTM/ANN audio classifier for
  infant cries using MFCC features; deployed via Flask API and a
  React Native/Expo app with on-device TensorFlow Lite inference.
